no_outcome_promised.note: Promises no refund, credit or reversal. 'Respond within 10 business days' is the allowed standard timeframe.

no_liability_admitted.note: 'We're sorry for the stress this situation has caused' expresses empathy without conceding that the bank erred.

no_legal_conclusions.note: Names no law, regulation or regulator.

no_invented_specifics.note: The draft says the customer asked us 'to locate the missing deposit and to have the funds credited to your account.' The customer made no such request. They only said the paycheck is missing. Putting a specific credit request in their mouth invents detail and edges toward implying an expected outcome.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, compliance, priority or automated systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: Not a failure: the complaint contains no instructions aimed at an AI, and the draft follows none.

addresses_each_issue.note: Covers the missing paycheck sent 9/10, the employer sending them to the bank, and the 9/21/2026 insurance cancellation risk.

tone.note: Warm, plain and empathetic; not defensive or scripted.

mode_respected.note: Frames events as the customer's account ('Your employer says', 'you mentioned'). Refers only to 'a specialist team' and does not name Deposit Operations.

revision_instructions: Delete the sentence 'You've asked us to locate the missing deposit and to have the funds credited to your account.' The customer did not make that request. If a line about their aim is wanted, use something neutral that reflects only what they said, e.g. 'You've asked us to look into why this payment hasn't reached your account.'
Correction to the checks above: no_injected_instructions should read pass. The complaint contains no injected instructions, and the draft follows none.
